simple.meaning: Tarshish , a place on the Mediterranean, hence, the ephithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תַּרְשִׁישׁ (H8659) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m n-pr-loc.
